facts: QualificationLevel: domain-owned code and ordered rank within exact definition
QualificationSubject and PartySubject: typed subject handle and Party mapping
QualificationRequirement: definition and optional minimum level
Qualification: immutable issuer-identified award with validity and optional EvidenceSeal
operations: Qualifications.award(subject, definition, level?, issuer, issuerRecord, issuedAt, expiresAt?, support?)
invariants: Evaluation/Assurance producers and Routing consumers use upper bridges. Qualification does not import Assurance, Routing or Allocation.
Technician/vendor/Runner; validity/revocation; level-comparison compatibility; issuer/evidence pins; typed Party and machine subjects; award grants no authorization.
Ranks compare only within the exact immutable definition; no implicit cross-version equivalence
Awards and revocations are append-only with issuer-record and terminal uniqueness
Qualification grants no authorization; eligible lookup consumes pages and rechecks hidden terminal/support facts
Routing acceptance and actual attestation-producer adapters remain separately verified upper integrations
